    Kronecker modules: basic API #

    Kronecker modules are functors WalkingParallelPair ⥤ ModuleCat k (Statement.Kron). This file provides constructors, componentwise extensionality, the subcategory C (Definition 2.1), Lemma 2.2(1), and subrepresentations Kron.Sub.
